name: andicas-resort-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for Andicas Bioparque & Eco-Resort. Allows AI agents to query cabin availability, pricing, romantic packages, and booking policies.

tools.name: get_cabins
tools.description: Returns the complete catalog of luxury cabins at Andicas Eco-Resort including official rates, capacities, and private jacuzzi features.

has_jacuzzi.description: Filter by cabins with private hot tubs / jacuzzis

tools.name: calculate_stay_budget
tools.description: Calculates the exact total budget for a stay at Andicas Eco-Resort, including nights, recommended cabin, add-on packages (romantic decor, cheeseboard, minibar), 50% deposit required to book, and remaining balance due at check-in.

cabin_id.description: ID of the cabin (e.g. santuario-palmas, nido-ancestral, casa-arbol, cueva-sol, refugio-rio, manantial-secreto)

include_all_extras.description: Whether to include the complete $195.000 COP experience package

tools.name: get_resort_info
tools.description: Returns location, directions from Panaca / Armenia, check-in and check-out hours, pet-friendly policies, and official contact channels.
